property_summary: Rule: if a withdrawAll call by a depositor returns successfully, the caller's entire credited amount must actually have been transferred out (observed by a recording callee that can be switched to revert); the mutant removes the require(callResult) check, so a failing transfer still yields a successful withdrawAll with zero value paid out.
change_summary: Delete `require(callResult);` so failed external calls no longer revert, leaving balance decremented without a successful transfer.
